label: Glass Unloader
Schedule

Enable time-based unloading *Unloads idle tabs on a timer rather than waiting for memory pressure. Firefox's own unloader only fires when free memory drops below browser.low_commit_space_threshold_mb, which on a healthy machine is almost never. Nothing is ever closed -- this calls the same discard the tab context menu's Unload Tab uses.*

Unload after this many seconds idle *Typed, not a menu, so you can use short values while testing. 1800 is 30 minutes, 60 is one minute, 10 is fine for confirming it works. Minimum 5. Measured from the tab's lastAccessed timestamp, so switching to a tab resets it.*

Check every this many seconds *Typed, so testing does not mean waiting. Minimum 2. The sweep is a cheap attribute scan, so a short interval costs little, but there is no point checking far more often than the idle threshold.*
Maximum tabs unloaded per sweep *Caps how many tabs are discarded at once. Unloading is cheap individually but a large burst can stutter. 0 removes the cap.*
Always keep at least this many tabs loaded *A floor on loaded tabs regardless of idle time, so a long session never collapses to nothing. 0 disables the floor.*
Never unload
Essentials *Zen keeps Essentials loaded deliberately -- they are the tabs you want instant. Turn this off to let them unload like any other tab.*
Pinned tabs *Applies to normally pinned tabs, separate from Essentials.*
Tabs playing audio or video *Checks the soundplaying attribute, the same signal the speaker icon uses. A paused video does not count as playing.*
Tabs asking for attention *Skips tabs flagged with the attention attribute, which Firefox sets for background tabs that have something to report.*
Tabs with unsubmitted form data *Reads SessionStore's formdata for the tab. If the check itself fails the tab is kept, so an unreadable state never costs you typed input.*
Tabs sharing camera, mic or screen *Unloading a tab mid-call drops the call.*
Tabs in picture-in-picture *Unloading a tab that owns a PiP window closes that window.*
Glance tabs *Zen's Glance overlay tabs.*
Split view tabs *Both halves of a split view are visible, so unloading either is disruptive.*

Never unload URLs containing *Comma-separated fragments matched against the full URL, for example: mail.google.com, localhost, docs.google. Empty matches nothing. Zen's own zen.tab-unloader.excluded-urls does not apply here.*
Troubleshooting

Log decisions to the Browser Console *Writes each unload and sweep summary under [GlassUnloader]; open with Ctrl+Shift+J. Also available there: GlassUnloader.status() lists every tab with its idle time and the exact reason it was kept or is eligible, and GlassUnloader.sweepNow() runs a sweep immediately.*
